name: pi-btw
notes: Local divergence: extensions/btw.ts migrates the hand-written transcript state machine (~200 lines) to the shared @xzzpig/pi-components builder API (appendEntry/ensureTurn/finishTurn/findLatestEntry/ensureToolCall/upsertText/upsertToolResult/removeTranscriptTurn/hasStreamingTranscriptEntry); entry/state types now alias the library's TranscriptEntry/TranscriptState. Behavior-equivalent (58/58 tests match pre-migration baseline). @xzzpig/pi-components is bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published to npm). Intentional local-only change; upstream has no dependency on @xzzpig/pi-components.
